The same agentSettings entry can change the model and priority for one worker. See the settings reference before launching a task.

Fast mode

Set fast: true on a task or in agentSettings.worker.fast to choose a supported priority tier. This may use more of the account quota.

Fast mode requires a supported native model. External runners and providers use their own scheduling policies.

  • Choose a capable worker for a bounded task with modelName. Keep the model reference available for comparison.
